notes.title: In December, a new big update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. I'm preparing a new update. I'm testing it for bugs. The next update will have a big map with lots of loot. Maybe there will be some New Year's events. The game will be updated. As you might have noticed, I made the update because the previous level didn't go through because of some copyright issues. I will deal with it
